located_point.method: Compared indexed point and nearby land between two drainage channels with Ruikar et al.2013 p.487 description of a fortified site near the Kotadi/Tharavadi confluence. Candidate enclosure visible; wall-face identity remains uncertain.

composite.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026
composite.transformation: Median per band; brightness mean of B02 B03 B04 B08

sources.assessment: Candidate rectangle and vegetation are unresolved mixtures at 10 m. Cannot separate a fortification face from a trench or plot boundary. No line accepted.

notes: Description confirms cactus growth on fortification and Late Mature Harappan architecture but does not identify a precise image face. No eligible north-bearing plan or registration. Download of another coastal-sites chapter was not performed after automatic approval rejection of a combined command.
unmeasurable_reason: No eligible plan; candidate enclosure has no securely identifiable wall face at 10 m.
imagery_assessment: Candidate rectangle and vegetation are unresolved mixtures at 10 m. Cannot separate a fortification face from a trench or plot boundary. No line accepted.
plan_assessment: Live library has no plan. Ruikar et al.2013 p.489 Figs3-4 are ground photographs, not orthographic plans. Its commercial image on p.488 was not viewed. Commercial panels in Abhayan et al.2025 excluded.

empirical_error_calibration.sigma_policy: Tool sigma retained unchanged; calibration is separate.
